summary: Snooze takes a chat out of Recents until a time or a pull request event, then brings it back with a Woke marker; the agent is never paused. This change is the backend, behind the staged flag chat_snooze (CHAT_SNOOZE_ENABLED in src/shared/chat-snooze.ts, false), so no client offers Snooze yet. Rules (src/shared/chat-snooze.ts, shared fixture tests/fixtures/chat-snooze-cases.json): the preset resolver (Later today: 3 hours rounded up to :00 or :30 and only while it ends today before 21:00; Tonight 20:00 while more than an hour away; Tomorrow morning 09:00; Next week the next Monday 09:00; soonest first; one item per minute), editable preset specs (time of day, weekday and time, duration; at most 8), pickPreset (a duration counts from the click, a clock time keeps the instant the menu showed and is refused once past), custom date and time validation that refuses a rolled-over date and a time a DST change skips and takes the first of a repeated one, wake labels, and shouldWakeOn: the time, an open card, a failure newer than the snooze, a message a person sent (Send to) and a change of the watched PR wake it; a normal turn end, an agent's message and anything older than the snooze do not. Storage: conversations gains snoozed_until, snoozed_at, snooze_pr, snooze_pr_mark, snooze_rev, woke_at and woke_reason, written through resolveRootThreadId; snooze_rev moves on every change, so a stale timer or Undo is refused; a wake clears every snooze field in one statement and keeps the Woke marker apart. A user turn (turn acceptance or a stored user message) and a settle clear the snooze and the marker in their own write; an archive ends the snooze. ChatSnoozer (src/main/conversations/chat-snooze.ts) keeps one timer per timed snooze, capped at 2^31-1 ms, rebuilt at start, every 5 minutes and when the Mac wakes, so a snooze that ended while closed wakes on the next start; a timer whose revision moved does nothing. It runs on the desktop and on the headless server. The registry wakes a chat on request.opened, question.asked, plan.proposed and error, and on a peer message only when a person sent it. A snooze is refused while the chat needs the user (an open card or an errored session). Channels app:snooze-conversation, app:unsnooze-conversation (Wake, and Undo with a revision), app:mark-woke-seen and the broadcast app:conversation-snoozed, open to a phone's chat scope; capability chat_snooze_v1. A wake on its time sends one push (kind woke) under the existing push policy; a card or an error already sends its own. PR wakes (feat/snooze-pr-wake): a snooze may name a linked PR by its prKey. The backend reads the PR when the snooze is made, refuses a merged or closed PR (pr_closed) or one it cannot read (pr_unreadable), and stores the baseline (state, head commit, checks failed) with the snooze in one write. While any snoozed chat waits on a PR, the snoozer reads each such PR every 5 minutes, one read per PR, in series, and stops when none waits. Only three events wake, each forward from the baseline (prWakeSummary): the PR merged; a review requested changes after the snooze started; the checks failed on a head that had not failed (a new push that fails counts). A read that goes back wakes nothing; a failed read is logged and tried at the next tick; a wake uses the snooze revision, so a re-snooze in between is not woken. A merge first stores the state on the PR's links, so an idle chat settles (the Settle notice) and its snooze ends there with no wake and no push; a busy one wakes with 'PR #n merged' and one push. Every settle broadcast now names the snooze it ended (endedSnooze), so the client's Undo can snooze the chat again.

desktop.followUpRelease: The Snooze sidebar release (feat/snooze-sidebar), which adds the row buttons, menu, Snoozed group, Woke marker and undo notice and turns CHAT_SNOOZE_ENABLED on for the desktop.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: The Snooze phones release (feat/snooze-phones): Home > Recents filter, the Snoozed shelf with Wake, long-press presets, the Woke mark and app:mark-woke-seen, only against a backend with chat_snooze_v1.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: The Snooze phones release (feat/snooze-phones): ChatSnooze.kt runs tests/fixtures/chat-snooze-cases.json, and HomePresenter gains the filter, the shelf, the long-press menu and the Woke mark.

updateRelease.reason: Nothing user-visible ships in this change: the flag is off and no client offers Snooze. The sidebar release adds the CHANGELOG and docs/features.md entries.

automated: tests/unit/chat-snooze-rules.test.ts: the shared fixture for presets (Sunday, Monday, 17:29, 17:45, 18:59, 19:00, 20:59 on 31 December, custom presets), pickPreset across midnight and after the time, wake labels, custom times (past, rolled-over dates, bad clocks, too far), shouldWakeOn and preset parsing; a child process in America/New_York refuses 02:30 on 14 March 2027 and takes 01:30 EDT on 1 November 2026.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-db.test.ts: the migration adds the seven columns to a database from before them and runs again with no change; writes and reads go to the root row through a rotated id; a wake clears every snooze field together and keeps the marker, seen never brings the snooze back; a revision that moved refuses a write; a user message, a turn accepted under a rotated id and a settle end the snooze; an assistant message does not.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-timer.test.ts (fake clock, real database): wake at the time with one push and a broadcast; refusals (needs you, past, too far, empty, no row); a stale timer after a re-snooze; timers rebuilt on a restart and a snooze that ended while closed woken at once; the 2^31-1 ms cap; resync; early wakes on a card and a newer failure but not on an agent message, a normal end or an older failure; Undo of a wake refused once the revision moved or the time passed; seen and archive.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-rules.test.ts prWake fixture cases (merged, closed, changes requested before and after the snooze, checks failed, already failed on that head, failed again on a new push, a push alone, a merge outranking the rest); tests/unit/chat-snooze-timer.test.ts with a fake PR reader: baseline stored and closed or unreadable PRs refused, a read every 5 minutes, a wake with one push on changes requested and no reads after it, one read for two chats on the same PR, a failed read tried again, a merge that settles an idle chat (no wake, no push) or wakes a busy one, no reads when no chat waits on a PR, and the settle broadcast naming the snooze it ended.
notExercised: No client calls the channels yet (flag off); the sidebar and phones releases exercise them in the app.
PR wakes were not run against a real GitHub or Bitbucket pull request; the reads go through the same service detail read the Reviews page uses.
